title.notes: Title screen + opening cinematic. Moderate — supports the 14-line narrative without competing.

village.notes: Long-session exploration music. Soft so players aren't fatigued.

dungeon.notes: Very soft — ambient only. Footsteps + NPC bubbles + sound design sit above it.

battle.notes: ATB Last Stand combat. Drives tension. Quick crossfade — combat is a moment, not a state.

victory.notes: Plays once on battle win. Hard fade-in (celebratory beat), gentle fade-out into next state.

defeat.notes: Plays once on battle loss. Softer than victory — let the loss land slowly.

transitions.rationale: Mood shift — quieter, sets the dungeon's quiet-stakes register
Celebratory beat needs the cut to land. No mush.
Slow grief beat. The loss should sink in, not slap.
Return to dungeon if win was a scripted encounter inside
Slow return; breathing room before village softness lands

volumeNudges.purpose: Lets the Mentor's line land without music competition
The journal entry IS the moment
Total silence before boss reveal. Battle track then hard-cuts in.
Lets the player register Heart-Wing visually before music re-asserts

accessibility.prefersReducedMotion: All fades become hard cuts / snap to target volume instantly.
accessibility.masterMute: Cuts all music immediately, ignores fade durations.
accessibility.firstTapUnlock: Audio context unlocks on first user gesture; queued plays fire as hard cut on first gesture.
